adOptions.description: Only ads with these media or offer options. Leave empty for all.
adOptions.title: Ad options

bodyType.description: Car body types. Leave empty for all. For non-car vehicle types use the advanced extraFilters instead, because mobile.de has class-specific body options.
bodyType.title: Body type

color.description: Only these exterior colours. Leave empty for all.
color.title: Exterior colour

country.description: Only vehicles offered in this country. Leave empty for every market.
country.title: Seller country

damagedOnly.description: Keep only listings mobile.de marks as damaged vehicles.
damagedOnly.title: Damaged vehicles only

extraFilters.description: Advanced pass-through for mobile.de filter parameters not exposed above, e.g. {"fe": ["ABS", "NAVIGATION_SYSTEM"], "cy": "6:8"}. Values are appended to the search query.
extraFilters.sectionDescription: Optional raw mobile.de filter parameters. Use only when the normal filters do not cover a need.
extraFilters.title: Advanced extra filters

forceResidentialProxy.description: Skip the direct attempt and use the configured proxy immediately. Useful on short schedules or when direct requests are repeatedly blocked.
forceResidentialProxy.title: Force proxy from the first request

fuelType.description: Only these fuel types. Leave empty for all fuels.
fuelType.sectionDescription: Narrow by equipment, condition, emissions and seller. Values marked with a class restriction only apply to that vehicle type.
fuelType.title: Fuel type

includeDealerProfile.description: Add the dealer's opening hours, languages, member-since date, rating breakdown, contact person and resolved homepage from the listing detail.
includeDealerProfile.title: Include dealer profile

includeDetails.description: Fetch each listing's detail page for the seller description, complete equipment list, full spec table, gallery, finance offers and dealer profile. One extra request per vehicle.
includeDetails.title: Include full listing details

includeImages.description: Include the complete photo list in each record. The preview image is always included.
includeImages.title: Include all image URLs

includeReviews.description: Fetch the dealer's public review page and add the aggregate rating plus up to 10 recent reviews. Reviews are cached per dealer within a run; private sellers have none.
includeReviews.title: Include dealer reviews

includeSimilarAds.description: Fetch mobile.de's similar-vehicle list for each listing and add a compact similarAds array (up to 10 ads) plus similarAdsTotal.
includeSimilarAds.title: Include similar ads

inspectionValidMonths.description: Cars only: remaining main inspection (TÜV/HU) validity.
inspectionValidMonths.title: Inspection valid for at least (months)

listingIds.description: Mobile.de listing IDs (e.g. 432394659) or listing URLs to fetch directly. Use this for exact vehicles you already know.
listingIds.title: Listing IDs

location.description: German town, postcode, or coordinates (latitude,longitude) to search around. Places are resolved with mobile.de's own suggestions.
location.sectionDescription: Search around a place and choose the result order.
location.title: Location

make.description: Manufacturer as mobile.de spells it, e.g. Volkswagen, BMW, Mercedes-Benz. Names are resolved against mobile.de's own make list; an unknown name falls back to a free-text keyword search.
make.title: Make

maxEngineCc.description: Highest engine displacement in cubic centimetres. 0 or empty means no upper bound.
maxEngineCc.title: Maximum engine size (ccm)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of vehicles to return across all queries and URLs. mobile.de serves at most 2,000 rows per individual query.
maxItems.sectionDescription: Control the row count and optional detail enrichment.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxMileage.description: Highest odometer reading in kilometres. 0 or empty means no upper bound.
maxMileage.title: Maximum mileage (km)

maxPowerKw.description: Highest engine power in kilowatts. 0 or empty means no upper bound.
maxPowerKw.title: Maximum power (kW)

maxPrice.description: Highest gross price in euros. 0 or empty means no upper bound.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price (EUR)

maxSeats.description: Highest number of seats. 0 or empty means no upper bound.
maxSeats.title: Maximum seats

maxYear.description: Latest first-registration year. 0 or empty means no upper bound.
maxYear.title: First registration to (year)

minEngineCc.description: Lowest engine displacement in cubic centimetres. 0 or empty means no lower bound.
minEngineCc.title: Minimum engine size (ccm)

minMileage.description: Lowest odometer reading in kilometres. 0 or empty means no lower bound.
minMileage.title: Minimum mileage (km)

minPowerKw.description: Lowest engine power in kilowatts. 0 or empty means no lower bound.
minPowerKw.title: Minimum power (kW)

minPrice.description: Lowest gross price in euros. 0 or empty means no lower bound.
minPrice.title: Minimum price (EUR)

minSeats.description: Lowest number of seats. 0 or empty means no lower bound.
minSeats.title: Minimum seats

minYear.description: Earliest first-registration year. 0 or empty means no lower bound. New, unregistered cars may have no first registration.
minYear.title: First registration from (year)

mode.description: How to find vehicles. Auto infers from the inputs: listing IDs/URLs → details, filters/keywords → search, otherwise the start URLs. Use Search to build a query from filters, URLs to paste search/spec/listing/dealer links, and Details to fetch exact listing IDs.
mode.sectionDescription: Pick a mode or leave Auto. Search needs filters or keywords; URLs accepts search, spec, listing and dealer links; Details takes listing IDs or listing links.
mode.title: Mode

model.description: Model or model series of the make, e.g. Golf, 3er, C-Class. Requires make for exact resolution; otherwise it is used as free text.
model.title: Model

onlineSinceDays.description: Only listings published within this many days.
onlineSinceDays.title: Online since

previousOwners.description: Maximum number of previous owners (cars, motorbikes, motorhomes).
previousOwners.title: Previous owners

priceRating.description: mobile.de's own price-fairness rating (cars only). Leave empty for all.
priceRating.title: Price rating

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The actor tries a direct connection first; the configured proxy is used automatically only after a block. Apify residential (DE) is a reliable fallback.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: No proxy is required. The actor switches to this proxy automatically when mobile.de blocks the direct connection.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

radiusKm.description: Distance from the location. Used only when a location is set.
radiusKm.title: Radius (km)

searchQueries.description: Free-text terms matched against the listing title and description, e.g. "volkswagen golf" or "panoramic roof". Each query runs as its own search and results are deduplicated by listing ID.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

sellerId.description: Only vehicles sold by this dealer (mobile.de seller ID). A numeric dealer URL also works in Start URLs.
sellerId.title: Seller ID

sellerType.description: Dealer, private seller, or company vehicles.
sellerType.title: Seller type

sortBy.description: Result order. Operating-hours sorts apply to machines; year sorts use construction year where the class has no first registration.
sortBy.title: Sort results by

startUrls.description: Mobile.de search URLs (suchen.mobile.de/fahrzeuge/search.html?...), model/spec URLs (suchen.mobile.de/auto/volkswagen-golf.html), listing URLs, or dealer links. Mixed lists are allowed.
startUrls.title: Start URLs

transmission.description: Only these gearbox types. Leave empty for all.
transmission.title: Transmission

vatReclaimableOnly.description: Keep only listings where VAT is shown separately (VAT-deductible).
vatReclaimableOnly.title: VAT reclaimable only

vehicleType.description: Which mobile.de vehicle class to search. Body types and some filters differ between classes.
vehicleType.sectionDescription: All filters are optional. Ranges accept 0 or empty for no bound. Filters apply in Search mode and to dealer stock.
vehicleType.title: Vehicle type
